inlineSql: Select ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.VCH_DATE,A.VCH_NO,A.SR_NO) AS SrNo,A.AC_CODE,C.AC_NAME,C.AC_MOBILE,A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,A.ORD_DEL_DATE AS DEL_DATE,D.IT_NAME,A.DESIGN_NO,A.ITM_SIZE,A.ITM_REMARK,A.ITM_GWT,A.ITM_PCS, A.DESIGN_ISU,F.AC_NAME AS KR_NAME,E.VCH_DATE AS KR_ISU_DT,TAG_GEN,G.VCH_DATE AS KR_REC_DT,G.TAG_NO,A.TAG_SALE,G.ITM_GWT As TAG_GWT,G.ITM_NWT As TAG_NWT,E.ORNA_REC_DATE,I.EMP_NAME,A.NET_AMT,A.ORD_REC_AMT,A.ITM_TOUCH,A.ITM_FINE,A.ITM_COLOR,B.FUN_DATE,A.CO_BOOK,A.CO_YEAR,B.ADV_AMT,B.OLD_GL,B.OLD_SL FROM (((((((SL_ORD_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN SL_ORD_DATA AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE And A.CO_YEAR = B.CO_YEAR And A.CO_BOOK = B.CO_BOOK And A.VCH_NO = B.VCH_NO) LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS D ON A.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = D.IT_CODE) LEFT JOIN APR_DETL AS E ON A.CO_CODE = E.CO_CODE AND A.CO_YEAR = E.ISU_YRCD AND A.CO_BOOK = E.ISU_DBCD AND A.VCH_NO = E.ISU_NO AND A.SR_NO = E.ISU_SRNO) LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE And A.AC_CODE = C.AC_CODE)LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS F ON E.CO_CODE = F.CO_CODE AND E.AC_CODE = F.AC_CODE) LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS G ON A.CO_CODE = G.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = G.LC_CODE AND A.CO_YEAR = G.ORD_YRCD AND A.CO_BOOK = G.ORD_DBCD AND A.VCH_NO = G.ORD_NO AND A.OLD_SRNO = G.ORD_SRNO) LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS H ON A.CO_CODE = H.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = H.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = H.CO_BOOK) LEFT JOIN EMP_MAST AS I ON A.CO_CODE = I.CO_CODE AND A.EMP_CODE = I.EMP_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.VCH_NO = ' ? ' ? And B.EMP_CODE = ' ? ' ? C ? AND H.DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? and A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' and A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? '
Select * From USER_SET WHERE LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND USER_NAME = ' ? ' AND SUB_MENU = ' ? '
SELECT Sum(CR_AMT - DR_AMT) as BalAmt FROM AC_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? ' and VCH_DATE < ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' HAVING SUM(CR_AMT-DR_AMT) <> 0
Select * From AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT AC_NAME As AcNameL,AC_CODE As AcCodeL, AC_GR AS GroupL,AC_ADD1 As AddressL,AC_PHONE As PhoneL,AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY AC_NAME

SELECT Sum(CR_AMT - DR_AMT) as BalAmt FROM AC_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? ' and VCH_DATE < ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? C ? AND DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? HAVING SUM(CR_AMT-DR_AMT) <> 0

SELECT A.AC_NAME As AcNameL,A.AC_CODE As AcCodeL,B.AC_GR_NAME AS GroupL,A.AC_AREA As AreaL,A.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,A.AC_CITY As CityL,A.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_GR = B.AC_GR WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.LC_CODE,A.AC_NAME

SELECT C.AC_NAME As AcNameL,C.AC_CODE As AcCodeL,D.AC_GR_NAME AS GroupL,C.AC_AREA As AreaL,C.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,C.AC_CITY As CityL,C.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST AS C LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS D ON C.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND C.AC_GR = D.AC_GR WHERE C.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND CAST(C.AC_CODE AS INT) < 100 UNION ALL SELECT A.AC_NAME,A.AC_CODE,B.AC_GR_NAME,A.AC_AREA,A.AC_ADD1,A.AC_CITY,A.AC_MOBILE FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_GR = B.AC_GR WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CAST(A.AC_CODE AS INT) >=200 ORDER BY C.AC_NAME
SELECT * FROM SL_ORD_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND VCH_NO = ' ? '

SELECT A.VCH_NO As VchNoL,replace(convert(NVARCHAR,A.VCH_DATE, 103), ' ', '/') AS VchDateL,A.AC_NAME As PartyNameL,A.VCH_DESC As VchDescL,A.ADV_AMT As OrdAmtR,SUM(CASE WHEN ORD_SIGN = '-' THEN ORD_AMT ELSE 0 END) As AdjAmtR FROM SL_ORD_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN SL_ORD_ADJ AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And A.LC_CODE = B.ORD_LC AND A.CO_YEAR = B.ORD_YRCD AND A.CO_BOOK = B.ORD_DBCD AND A.VCH_NO = B.ORD_NO WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,A.AC_NAME,A.VCH_DESC,A.ADV_AMT ORDER BY A.VCH_DATE,A.VCH_NO
Select * From EMP_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND EMP_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT EMP_NAME As EmpNameL,EMP_CODE As EmpL FROM EMP_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY EMP_NAME

Select A.TAG_NO,A.VCH_SRNO,B.VCH_DATE FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = B.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = B.VCH_SRNO WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO = ' ? ' AND B.EMP_ISU <> 'Y' GROUP BY A.TAG_NO,A.VCH_SRNO,B.VCH_DATE ORDER BY B.VCH_DATE DESC
SELECT * FROM TAG_IMAGE_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAG_NO = ' ? ' AND VCH_SRNO = ?
Select * From LOCT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? '
Select LC_CODE As CodeL,LC_NAME As NameL,LC_ADD1 As AddressL,LC_CITY As CityL FROM LOCT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY LC_CODE
